description: A round black-rimmed tray filled with white sand sits on a sheet of paper on the table, with a small stone near the top of the sand and a small yellow rake nearby. The left hand stays resting to the left while the right hand picks up the yellow rake and repeatedly drags its flat head across the sand in short strokes, moving around the stone and shifting from the upper-right area toward the center and along the rim to smooth and comb the surface before lifting and repositioning for the next pass.
